description: Recruitment cycles cannot declare amendment surface complete without verified monitoring audit and cryptographically verified corrigenda.

requirementsForChainVerified.baseNotificationVerified: baseNotification must have sourceState === SHA_VERIFIED and valid 64-hex SHA-256.
requirementsForChainVerified.auditScopeDefined: amendmentAudit.auditScope must specify audited portal surface.
requirementsForChainVerified.auditWindowCurrent: amendmentAudit.auditWindowThrough must record timestamp up to which corrigenda portal was audited.
requirementsForChainVerified.corrigendaShaVerified: Every document in applicableCorrigenda must have sourceState === SHA_VERIFIED and valid SHA-256.

derivationStates.CURRENT_CHAIN_VERIFIED: Base notice verified + audit scope recorded + audit window recorded + all corrigenda SHA_VERIFIED.
derivationStates.CHAIN_PARTIAL: Audit scope missing OR audit window missing OR one or more corrigenda only URL_FOUND / METADATA_INDEXED.
derivationStates.CHAIN_UNRESOLVED: Base notification is unverified or amendment surface has not been audited.
